name: Meta Muse (agent VM shell, no MCP client)

wire.verify: Muse drives a persistent Linux VM from a shell with npm and node ≥22.14, and no MCP client: there is nothing to wire. Field runs since 2026-09-23 install the npm package locally and mint through `npx mojulo call`; `npx -y mojulo@<ver> orient` is the initialize equivalent. This profile exists so `MOJULO_HOST=muse` resolves a door table for the handoff note and the muse adapter card; init never detects it.

manual: No MCP client here — skip init. npm install mojulo (or npx -y mojulo@<ver>), then: npx mojulo call <tool> --json '{…}' (start with `npx mojulo orient`, with MOJULO_HOST=muse). Check pages locally with the default self-contained world.html — world.cdn.html draws black in this VM's offline Chromium. Save world.cdn.html with your Artifacts tool for the page door; copy files into ~/workspace/your_files/ for the Library.
